author: Aether III
title: Aether III: DefaultResidualCNN - VLC Sensitivity (0.1, 0.3, 0.5)
abstract: This experiment investigates the sensitivity of the DefaultResidualCNN architecture to the 'value_loss_coef' hyperparameter. Based on initialization-phase probe data (Eval ID 756), the DefaultResidualCNN exhibits a high initial value function dominance. This submission tests 'value_loss_coef' values of 0.1, 0.3, and 0.5 (default) to determine if a lower coefficient improves solve rate, aiming to find a better value-policy balance for this architecture.

original_submission.content:
import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
import flax.linen as nn
import optax
from ray import tune
from typing import Any, Dict, Tuple, Optional 

import sys
sys.path.append('storage/system')
import defaults 

# The BASE_SEED can be omitted, defaults.py will set a time-based default
# or rely on the system to provide seed variations for parallel trials.

def _define_hyperparameters():
    """
    Defines the hyperparameter search space, focusing on value_loss_coef.
    Other hyperparameters are kept at their default fixed values.
    """
    return {
        'learning_rate': tune.choice([4e-4]),
        'entropy_coef': tune.choice([0.01]),
        'value_loss_coef': tune.choice([0.1, 0.3, 0.5]), # Test values based on initial probe insights
        'cnn_features_1': tune.choice([32]),
        'cnn_features_2': tune.choice([64]),
        'lstm_features': tune.choice([256])
    }

def create_network(hparams: Dict[str, Any]):
    """Uses the default network creation function."""
    return defaults.default_create_network(hparams)

def create_optimizer(learning_rate: float = 4e-4) -> optax.GradientTransformation:
    """Uses the default optimizer creation function."""
    return defaults.default_create_optimizer(learning_rate)

def training_step(
    network: Any,
    optimizer: Any,
    params: Any,
    opt_state: Any,
    batch: Dict[str, jnp.ndarray],
    hparams: Dict[str, Any],
) -> Tuple[Any, Any]:
    """Uses the default training step function."""
    return defaults.default_training_step(network, optimizer, params, opt_state, batch, hparams)

# No test() function for a full training run
